name: Recital A
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
part_text: ‘whereas repeated outbreaks of violence in different parts of Syria, destabilisation attempts by partisans of Bashar al-Assad, as well as by Daesh forces, and an overall high number of arms in circulation, create a fragmented and volatile security situation in the country, which could undermine prospects for a stable, inclusive and Syrian-led political transition;’
